_about: Model preferences for tools/l10n/council.py. For each provider and role, the first pattern (a Python regular expression searched in the model id) that matches any listed model wins, and among its matches the highest version (natural sort) is chosen. Ids matching an exclude pattern are never chosen. The back-translator also skips every model that drafted the area. Edit this file, or pass --prefer, to change the choice; the exact ids used are recorded in the drafts and decisions.
